mainEntity.name: What information does AI need before it can write marketing content that actually fits my business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Give the assistant a clear role, audience, offer, voice, workflow, source policy, output format, and approval rules. Run My AI Biz calls these written instructions master prompts and shows how they can be adapted to a niche, product, audience, and objective. Key factors include examples of approved content, words to avoid, required calls to action, factual boundaries, and what the assistant must ask before proceeding. Provide real business context rather than a vague request for promotional copy. Test the instructions against several scenarios and revise them when the output misses the mark. Run My AI Biz can help you learn how specialized prompts become repeatable workflows.
